\documentclass{standalone}
\usepackage{tikz}
\pgfdeclarelayer{unlisted}
\pgfdeclarelayer{discard}
\begin{document}
\begin{tikzpicture}
  \draw[red] (0,0) -- (2,0);
  % Declared but not in the layer list: PGF reports an error and does not
  % paint it; it still counts for the bounding box.
  \begin{pgfonlayer}{unlisted}
    \draw[blue] (0,-1) -- (5,-1);
  \end{pgfonlayer}
  % The discard layer drops its content silently.
  \begin{pgfonlayer}{discard}
    \draw[magenta] (0,1) -- (2,1);
  \end{pgfonlayer}
  \draw[green] (0,0.5) -- (2,0.5);
\end{tikzpicture}
\end{document}
